text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, naproxen 250 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 363 tablets (19.5 days on hand at 18.6 tablets/day). Corvale General holds 251 tablets (13.6 days on hand at 18.5 tablets/day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows naproxen is not listed as of 2026-10-21. Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA (FEI 3011585599) received an OAI classification on 2022-05-19 and a Warning Letter on 2023-06-20, with a subsequent VAI inspection ending 2025-06-17. Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3008565058) received an OAI classification on 2025-02-14 and a Warning Letter on 2025-07-11. Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3004672766) received an OAI classification on 2022-05-20 and a Warning Letter on 2022-11-22, with a subsequent VAI inspection ending 2026-06-30.

Our position: Current inventory provides limited days on hand at both sites. The rule-based alternate manufacturer ranked first is Teva Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list and uses plant ACTAVIS LABS FL INC. Four additional manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list but their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Teva Pharmaceuticals, Inc. for both sites; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., Almatica Pharma LLC, and Alvogen Inc. as secondary sources; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage and update days-on-hand projections weekly; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
